name: Claude badge
author: Brett
description: Tests the AI connection every time the console loads and attaches a Claude badge to the banner (framework badge asset, top left). Connected: green, and a tooltip pops out to its right for 5 seconds saying “Powered by” and the model (e.g. Claude Opus 5.5). Not connected: grey, and the tooltip says “AI unavailable”. Uses the AI assistant's model service (axf.llm@1). Removing the plugin removes only the Claude badge; the banner, badge and clock asset types stay in the framework.
